actions.title: Recurring delay pattern: Marathahalli / S3
actions.narrative: Average delay in Marathahalli during shift S3 is 9.7 minutes, exceeding the fleet-wide average of 5.9 minutes by 3.8 minutes across 126 sampled trips. This gap is persistent across the full dataset period rather than a recent spike, indicating a structural cause such as a congested route or coverage gap.

actions.title: Cost/km creep: Vendor V2
actions.narrative: Vendor V2's cost per kilometer increased 12.6% to 12.30/km over the 42-day period, while remaining 2.66/km below the peer average of 14.95/km. This 12.6% increase occurred without any corresponding change in trip distance or delay/quality metrics, indicating a pure cost-per-unit creep.
